cases.summary: The driver satisfied all three NS-1 conditions for retaining the no-show fee. GPS shows the driver came within 31 m of the pickup (limit 150 m) and waited 430 s from first entering the threshold until cancelling (minimum 300 s). The driver also made three recorded contact attempts before cancelling (two messages and one call), exceeding the minimum of one. The rider's claim of being 'only a few minutes late' is contradicted by the timeline: the rider agreed to arrive in 2 minutes at 11:43:44Z but the driver did not cancel until 11:49:54Z, roughly 6 minutes later, and the rider never arrived.

arguments.claim: The driver came within 150 m of the pickup point, satisfying the first NS-1 condition.
The driver waited at least 300 seconds from first coming within 150 m until cancelling, satisfying the second NS-1 condition.
The driver made at least one recorded contact attempt before cancelling, satisfying the third NS-1 condition.
The rider acknowledged the driver's arrival and promised to come in 2 minutes but did not appear within the additional wait period, supporting the no-show determination.

cases.summary: The rider was charged a no-show fee after the driver cancelled. The rider claims they were only a few minutes late and the driver cancelled on them. However, the retrieved evidence shows all three NS-1 conditions for retaining the no-show fee were met: the driver came within 31 m of the pickup (limit 150 m), waited 430 seconds from first coming within 150 m until cancelling (minimum 300 s), and made three recorded contact attempts before cancelling (CHAT-01, CHAT-03, CALL-01; minimum 1). The rider's own chat message at 11:43:44Z said they were 'coming in 2 minutes,' but the driver did not cancel until 11:49:54Z, roughly six minutes later, and the rider never arrived. Under NS-1 and NS-2, the charge should be kept. The rider's claim that they were 'only a few minutes late' is not supported by the GPS wait time or the chat timeline.

arguments.claim: The driver met the proximity requirement: closest approach to the pickup was 31 m, well within the 150 m limit.
The driver met the minimum wait requirement: 430 seconds elapsed from first coming within 150 m until cancellation, exceeding the 300-second minimum.
The driver met the contact-attempt requirement: three recorded contact attempts were made before cancelling (two messages and one call).
The rider acknowledged the driver's arrival and said they were coming in 2 minutes, but did not arrive before the driver cancelled roughly six minutes later.

retrievedPolicies.ruleText: DEMONSTRATION POLICY. Retain the no-show fee only when the evidence shows all three conditions: the driver came within 150 metres of the pickup point; the driver waited at least 300 seconds from first coming within 150 metres until cancelling; and the driver made at least one recorded contact attempt (message or call) before cancelling.
retrievedPolicies.remedyCriteria: keep_charge when all three NS-1 conditions are met.
